obernants.observation_scope: Interp::run calls vm::run_program only after registration; VM Fallback invokes Interp::exec and DynEval invokes eval_multi through sync_out/sync_in. lib.rs exposes item identities consumed by tests. suite::run_fs consumes parser scenarios and feeds captured output to check; vm_gate compares engines independently of expected answers, so shared broken builtins can pass equivalence. layers/lib.rs is a separate tagged routing relation to math/global and Domain callbacks, with no mlab caller/callee edge; grouping does not imply runtime transport.

obernants.operator: Entire parse precedes registration/execution. Runtime failure follows already executed assignments and precedes remaining statements. Ordinary indexed '=' assignment orders RHS type, target type, then indices; compound indexed assignment first reads the indexed old value and applies its binary operation, then invokes the assignment helper, evaluating indices again; user calls order excess inputs, excess outputs, depth.
